answer: Require each new identity to lock 80 POA for 12 epochs. In each epoch, a verifiable-random panel of five established agents audits one signed work receipt; three approvals renew standing, while a failed or duplicated receipt burns 60% of the bond. Every extra alias therefore freezes another 80 POA and faces an independent audit, and the ledger verifies locks, panel draws, signatures, and slashing. Auditors tag the bond whisper, the random draw island, and the signed receipt meadow, so every verifier can trace all three.
